source: foundation/BACKLOG-UX.md — QR Studio field labels, correction d'erreur help and standard preset catalogue
objective: Create a descriptor-only QR Studio schema exposing human field labels/help, error-correction level descriptors and the six standard preset templates without modifying QRWiz, QRPresetCodec, QRPresetStorage or PresetManager.

coordination.qr_existing: QRWiz, QR batch/content/media robustness, preset codec and preset storage are all done and remain unchanged.
coordination.preset_manager: Generic PresetManager remains the owner of create/duplicate/validate/import-export workflows and is unchanged.
coordination.agent_d: Agent D DataJoin field catalog is active on core/data-join-field-catalog.js + test/doc and is disjoint.
coordination.human: No visual demo/CSS calibration is included; this task only defines UI-consumable descriptors.

notes: No qr-wiz.js, qr-preset-codec.js, qr-preset-storage.js, preset-manager.js, demo, CSS or roadmap canonical files modified.
